title: placeTrackerWork
responsibility: Ranks computers for new work by headroom, role and fit, and recommends the best one that fits.

inputs.name: trackerObservedDemand.kind
inputs.description: Requested kind of work, used to select matching process groups and cold-start estimates.

inputs.name: trackerObservedDemand.history
inputs.description: Resource samples containing CPU and memory peaks for recent process groups.

inputs.name: placeTrackerWork.rows
inputs.description: Status and latest sample of each candidate computer.

inputs.name: placeTrackerWork.request
inputs.description: Work kind, CPU and RAM demand, available launcher slots, reservations and excluded computers. Defaults to general work.

inputs.name: trackerMachineTargets.row
inputs.description: Fleet record holding the computer role and its configured limits.

inputs.name: trackerMachineTargets.sample
inputs.description: Latest sample with CPU and memory capacity for the computer.

outputs.name: trackerWorkRamGB
outputs.description: RAM in GB that each kind of work is assumed to need.

outputs.name: placeTrackerWork
outputs.description: Fitting computers first, ranked by RAM and slots for light work or CPU headroom for heavy work, with reasons and a recommendation.
